# AQUA-S: Authentication Solution QM {#authentication-solution-quality-model}

::: {.model-intro}
**AQUA-S** derives the Security factor and its subfactors, as well as five Usability subfactors, from **AQUA-E**. In addition, we identified two solution-specific Usability subfactors and two solution-specific quality factors: Privacy and Applicability. The [**Description**](#solution-table) documents them.
:::
